items.title: Jonah Coleman: Strikes for three TDs in Week 11
items.text:
Coleman reeled off 111 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries and hauled in four of five targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win against the Raiders.

items.title: Ladd McConkey: Finds end zone twice against Jets
items.text:
McConkey caught five of eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Coach optimistic about Week 12 availability
items.text:
Raiders coach Klink Kubiak said after Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos that he's optimistic Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) will be available to face the Browns on Nov. 29, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Omarion Hampton: Productive again in Week 11 loss
items.text:
Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards and caught his only target for four yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Effective complement to Hall in Week 11
items.text:
Allen rushed 16 times for 75 yards while catching his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
